correctness.rationale: The Fano plane properties prove diameter three and the complete equivalence between EGP and avoiding precisely 84 distinct length-three geodesic triples. The edge-bitmask recurrence covers every 2^21 subset by induction on its largest selected index, and a finite one-edge extension test characterizes all maximal sets. An independent BFS/DFS enumeration reproduces all 11 nonzero face coefficients and all four facet coefficients. The code is included and executable; finite completeness is explicit and does not rest on sampled evidence.

value.rationale: The fixed Fano plane incidence graph is a canonical, highly symmetric 21-edge cubic girth-six graph; its EGP forbidden geodesics have a natural geometric 84-triple description. The full cardinality and inclusion-maximal polynomials are exact nontrivial finite invariants, establish the previously unavailable 10-edge optimum with precisely 84 optimizers, and reveal a four-rank non-pure maximal complex. Those statements have natural use as a finite benchmark for geodesic avoidance algorithms and extend beyond a small or arbitrary normalization check.
